newsitem.title: USA: SIEBERT UNIT ACQUIRES STOCK MART ACCOUNTS.
newsitem.headline: SIEBERT UNIT ACQUIRES STOCK MART ACCOUNTS.

text.p: Siebert Financial Corp's Muriel Siebert & Co Inc said Tuesday it acquired the retail brokerage accounts of Stock Mart, the discount brokerage arm of William O'Neil Co Inc of Los Angeles.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The company said it expects to complete transfer of accounts by the close of business on September 15.
William O'Neil is a financial data and services firm which also publishes Investor's Business Daily.
